fix-handle-collective-multiple-host-on-d.reason: PR #11139 'hotfix: missing gCal calendarId' (2023-09-04) moved the "primary" fallback into selectedCalendar itself (`...find(cal => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId || "primary"`), so the hangout-link events.patch no longer receives an undefined calendarId. Today's main (packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts createEvent) keeps `externalCalendarId ?? (find(...)?.externalId || "primary")` and passes selectedCalendar to both insert and patch.
